info.description: Manage Drasl users, players, reports, bans, and invites
info.title: Drasl API

get.description: List active bans, optionally filtered by type. Requires admin privileges. Expired bans are removed before listing.

post.description: Create a user, player, name, skin, or cape ban. Requires admin privileges. User and player targets must already exist locally and cannot belong to an administrator.

get.description: Get one active ban by its UUIDv4 incident ID. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Immediately remove an active ban. Requires admin privileges.

patch.description: Update the reason, player-visible message, internal notes, or duration of a ban. Type and target are immutable. Requires admin privileges.

get.description: Get a challenge skin and challenge token for a player name for registration or player creation purposes. See the `RequireSkinVerification` configuration options.

parameters.description: Player name for the challenge skin
parameters.name: APIGetChallengeSkinRequest

get.description: Get details of all invites. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Create a new invite with a random code. Requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Delete an invite given its code. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Authenticate with username and password and receive an API token. Can be called without an API token.
post.summary: Authenticate and receive an API token

get.description: Get details of all players. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Create a new player for an existing Drasl user.

get.description: Get details of a player by their UUID. Requires admin privileges unless you own the player.

delete.description: Delete a player. This action cannot be undone. Requires admin privileges unless you own the player.

patch.description: Update an existing player. Requires admin privileges unless you own the player.

delete.description: Deleting a report does not remove bans created from it.

patch.summary: Update moderator notes on an open report

post.description: Legal targets are derived from the retained report evidence. Chat reports accept local participant player UUIDs, username reports use the captured name, and skin reports use captured skin/cape hashes.
post.summary: Apply report-constrained bans and archive the report
Dismiss and archive an open report

get.summary: Get the immutable original and normalized evidence for a report
Get a retained report texture snapshot

get.description: Get details of a user, either the calling user (GET /user) or the user with the specified UUID (GET /users/{uuid}). Getting details of another user requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Delete a user, either the calling user (DELETE /user) or the user with the specified UUID (DELETE /users/{uuid}). This action cannot be undone. Deleting another user requires admin privileges.

patch.description: Update an existing user, either the calling user (PATCH /user) or the user with the specified UUID (PATCH /users/{uuid}). Updating another user requires admin privileges.

post.summary: Link an OIDC identity to a user

parameters.description: OIDC identity to link to the user
parameters.name: APICreateOIDCIdentityRequest

delete.summary: Unlink an OIDC identity from a user

parameters.description: Issuer of the OIDC provider to unlink from the user
parameters.name: APIDeleteOIDCIdentityRequest

get.description: Get details of all users. Requires admin privileges.

post.description: Register and create a new user. Can be called without an API token.

get.description: Get details of a user, either the calling user (GET /user) or the user with the specified UUID (GET /users/{uuid}). Getting details of another user requires admin privileges.

delete.description: Delete a user, either the calling user (DELETE /user) or the user with the specified UUID (DELETE /users/{uuid}). This action cannot be undone. Deleting another user requires admin privileges.

patch.description: Update an existing user, either the calling user (PATCH /user) or the user with the specified UUID (PATCH /users/{uuid}). Updating another user requires admin privileges.

post.summary: Link an OIDC identity to a user

parameters.description: OIDC identity to link to the user
parameters.name: APICreateOIDCIdentityRequest

delete.summary: Unlink an OIDC identity from a user

parameters.description: Issuer of the OIDC provider to unlink from the user
parameters.name: APIDeleteOIDCIdentityRequest

internalNotes.example: Evidence is stored in moderation case 42.

reasonId.description: Required for a Mojang reason; omit to generate a custom ID of at least 60.

reasonMessage.description: Optional for Mojang IDs and required for custom IDs.

capeBase64.description: Optional. Base64-encoded cape PNG. Example value truncated for brevity. Do not specify both `capeBase64` and `capeUrl`.

capeUrl.description: Optional. URL to cape file. Do not specify both `capeBase64` and `capeUrl`.

challengeToken.description: Optional. Challenge token to use when verifying ownership of another player. Call /drasl/api/v3/challenge-skin first to get a skin and token. See the `RequireSkinVerification` configuration options.

chosenUuid.description: Optional. Specify a UUID for the new player. If omitted, a UUID will be generated according to the `PlayerUUIDGeneration` configuration option.

fallbackApiServer.description: Optional. If set, import an existing player from the named fallback API server (see the `ImportExistingPlayer` configuration option). If omitted, a new player is created.

fallbackPlayer.description: Optional. Can be a UUID or a player name. If you don't set a skin or cape, this player's skin on one of the fallback API servers will be used instead.

skinBase64.description: Optional. Base64-encoded skin PNG. Example value truncated for brevity. Do not specify both `skinBase64` and `skinUrl`.

skinModel.description: Optional. Skin model. Either "classic" or "slim". If omitted, `"classic"` will be assumed.

skinUrl.description: Optional. URL to skin file. Do not specify both `skinBase64` and `skinUrl`.

userUuid.description: Optional. UUID of the owning user. If omitted, the player will be added to the calling user's account.

capeBase64.description: Optional. Base64-encoded cape PNG. Example value truncated for brevity. Do not specify both `capeBase64` and `capeUrl`.

capeUrl.description: Optional. URL to cape file. Do not specify both `capeBase64` and `capeUrl`.

chosenUuid.description: Optional. Specify a UUID for the player of the new user. If omitted, a UUID will be generated according to the `PlayerUUIDGeneration` configuration option.

fallbackApiServer.description: Optional. If set, register by importing an existing player from the named fallback API server (see the `RegistrationPassword.ImportExistingPlayer` or the `RegistrationOIDC.ImportExistingPlayer` configuration option). If omitted, a new player is created.

fallbackPlayer.description: Can be a UUID or a player name. If you don't set a skin or cape, this player's skin on one of the fallback API servers will be used instead.

inviteCode.description: Invite code to use. Optional even if the `RequireInvite` configuration option is set; admin API users can bypass `RequireInvite`.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user is an admin

maxPlayerCount.description: Optional. Maximum number of players a user is allowed to own. -1 means unlimited players. -2 means use the default configured value.

password.description: Plaintext password. Not needed if OIDCIdentitySpecs are supplied.

playerName.description: Optional. Player name. Can be different from the user's username. If omitted, the user's username will be used.

preferredLanguage.description: Optional. One of the two-letter codes in https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/javase/jdk8-jre8-suported-locales.html. Used by Minecraft. If omitted, the value of the `DefaultPreferredLanguage` configuration option will be used.

requestApiToken.description: Whether to include an API token for the user in the response

skinBase64.description: Optional. Base64-encoded skin PNG. Example value truncated for brevity. Do not specify both `skinBase64` and `skinUrl`.

skinModel.description: Skin model. Either "classic" or "slim". If omitted, `"classic"` will be assumed.

skinUrl.description: Optional. URL to skin file. Do not specify both `skinBase64` and `skinUrl`.

username.description: Username of the new user. Can be different from the user's player name.

apiToken.description: An API token for the new user, if requested.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the invite was created

url.description: Link to register using the invite

apiToken.description: An API token for the user

capeUrl.description: URL to the user's cape, if they have set one. If no cape is set, the Minecraft client may still see a cape if `FallbackAPIServers` or default capes are configured.

createdAt.description: ISO datetime when the user was created

fallbackPlayer.description: UUID or player name. If the user doesn't have a skin or cape set, this player's skin on one of the fallback API servers will be used instead.

name.description: Player name, seen by Minecraft. Can be different from the owning user's username.

nameLastChangedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the user's player name was last changed

offlineUuid.description: UUID of the user in `online-mode=false` servers. Derived from the user's player name.

skinUrl.description: URL to the user's skin, if they have set one. If no skin is set, the Minecraft client may still see a skin if `FallbackAPIServers` or default skins are configured.

uuid.description: UUID of the player, seen by Minecraft. Not guaranteed to be different from the owning user's UUID.

permanent.description: Set true to remove the expiration date. Cannot be combined with expiresAt.

capeBase64.description: Optional. Base64-encoded cape PNG. Example value truncated for brevity.

deleteCape.description: Pass `true` to delete the user's existing cape

deleteSkin.description: Pass `true` to delete the user's existing skin

fallbackPlayer.description: Optional. New fallback player. Can be a UUID or a player name. If you don't set a skin or cape, this player's skin on one of the fallback API servers will be used instead.

name.description: Optional. New player name. Can be different from the user's username.

skinBase64.description: Optional. Base64-encoded skin PNG. Example value truncated for brevity.

skinModel.description: Optional. New skin model. Either "classic" or "slim".

isAdmin.description: Optional. Pass`true` to grant, `false` to revoke admin privileges.

isDisabled.description: Optional. Pass `true` to disable, `false` to enable the user.

maxPlayerCount.description: Optional. Maximum number of players a user is allowed to own. -1 means unlimited players. -2 means use the default configured value.

preferredLanguage.description: Optional. One of the two-letter codes in https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/javase/jdk8-jre8-suported-locales.html. Used by Minecraft.

resetApiToken.description: Pass `true` to reset the user's API token

resetMinecraftToken.description: Pass `true` to reset the user's Minecraft token. The replacement is returned in `minecraftToken`.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user is an admin

maxPlayerCount.description: Maximum number of players a user is allowed to own. -1 means unlimited players. -2 means use the default configured value.

minecraftToken.description: Secret token used instead of a password by Minecraft launchers.
